power.answer: Austrian Airlines applies the Lufthansa Group rule: two power banks per passenger in cabin baggage only, each up to 100 Wh (2 g lithium), none used or charged on board and none in the overhead locker. Approval for 100 to 160 Wh is requested at specialcases@austrian.com.

sections.h: 🔋 What Austrian says about power banks
sections.p: From the Austrian page "Electronic items and batteries", read on 22 November 2026.

list: Approval above 100 Wh: write to specialcases@austrian.com when you book; a power bank over 160 Wh is not accepted.

faq: Who do I ask about a larger power bank on Austrian?
Email specialcases@austrian.com when you book if the bank is between 100 and 160 Wh.
Can I use a power bank in my seat on Austrian?
No. Using and charging power banks is prohibited on board, except for approved medical devices.
